Bus Bombing in Syria Kills Two, Injures 13

An explosive device detonated on a minibus in Jaramana, a suburb of Damascus, Syria, on Thursday, killing at least two people and injuring 13. Syrian state media reported the incident, citing the health ministry. The blast tore off the vehicle's roof and scattered debris. No group has immediately claimed responsibility for the bombing. The explosion occurred during peak traffic hours.
